name: Waterview Creek (Jourama Falls) + Black Hole
description:
This walk starts from the Jourama Falls carpark and passes the upper falls lookout.  There is a very steep climb to the top of the escarpment, then a brief bush-bash down a gully into the walkable part of the creek upstream of the main falls.  There is a long (and not entirely straightforward) rock-hop / scramble up the creek to a five-star swimming hole with a small waterfall which we will reach in time for lunch.   We are also going to go to the Black Hole (finally).  We will be returning via the track that has been cut to the Black Hole.  

This will be a full day walk
For more info or to RSVP please contact Keith or contact tsvbush@hotmail.com (by Friday). 

Cost: members = free, visitors = $5 pp
All walkers must be 18+years.

name: The Terraces
description:
This walk will see us clambering beside about 10 – 15 waterfalls, depending on how far we get. We start from Private Property and make our way onto a powerline easement over very level country then we hit the national park. We travel along Palm Creek and then descend into the creek at the Princess Pool. Our journey then goes up one of the tributaries of Palm Creek (we can see it from the highway on our drive there). We do have to climb around several waterfalls (clambering up beside them). There is some exposure on some ascents but there are sufficient hand and foot holds to get us up and down safely.

We normally return the way we came, but taking a detour up to the rock slides for afternoon tea. Then it is back the way we came to our starting point. This walk does have its challenges, but it is not a particularly difficult walk. The clambering is not technical climbing, but you do have to gain some height in this manner.

For more information or to RSVP by Saturday 20/7: contact Phil (details distributed via email 15/7) or email the club at tsvbush@hotmail.com.

Cost: members are free, visitors $5pp.  
All participants must be 18+years of age.

name: July Bushwalk Planning Meeting
description:
The Townsville Bushwalking Club July walk planning meeting will be held on Monday 8 July @ 6pm at Blessed Mary Mackillop Parish meeting room (building behind the Church), 43 Ross River Road Mundingburra. 

We will be discussing walks for the rest of July/beginning of August. If you're interested in joining us on one of these walks please come along.

All welcome.

name: The Black Hole
description:
The mystery walk..... to the Black Hole....
Leaving from Jourama Falls, we will ascend up beside the waterfall and continue on towards Paluma to find The Black Hole.

This walk will be mostly off track and on a very rough track/footpad.  It will be a full day walk.

For more information or to RSVP please contact Wilfred (contact details distributed via email 12/6 (June Newsletter) or email tsvbush@hotmail.com

Cost: Members = free, visitors = $5
All participants must be 18+yrs of age
